summary: CooTek (Cayman) Inc., a Cayman-incorporated, Shanghai-based foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K announcing a board change effective November 6, 2026. Mr. Ye Yuan resigned as a director citing personal reasons, and Ms. Lili Guo, the Company's Head of Human Resources since July 2023, was appointed to the board the same day, leaving a three-member board. No terms, premium, consideration, advisor, or board recommendation are disclosed. This is a routine, non-abrupt directorship replacement rather than a forced CEO/CFO or contested-departure event; no deal mechanics or risk-arb angle apply.
